name: Open Items
rows: July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026 · USD · printed form year 2025
DRAFT · INCOMPLETE · human review and signature required
The $0.33 organization cost difference carried from FY2025 is still unresolved. Reviewer decision required; no plug posted.
The year-end trial balance is unapproved. Every figure on the return rests on it.
The executed limited partnership agreement has not been supplied. The 99.9% and 0.1% on item J, Schedule B-1, Schedule K-1 box 1, item L and the Analysis of Net Income are drafts.
The June 30, 2026 distributions of $239,760.00 and $240.00 have no signed authorization on file.

Only invoice HFC-26-0142 supports the expenses. Support for the 920 progress payments, the 22 commission payments, the six warranty claims and the $700.00 completion work has not been supplied; the Form 1125-A land, materials and subcontract labor split cannot be made without it.

The 2025 Form 1065 for July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026 is an unsigned draft and must not be filed. Page 1 items, Schedule B answers, both Schedules K-1, Form 1125-A, Schedule B-1 and the statements are filled from the client questionnaire dated November 3, 2026, which is the client's own unverified statement. Item K1, the partner percentages, the reserve treatment, the $0.33 and the Form 1125-A split are drafts or blanks, as listed in these open items. The return is late unless the Form 7004 is confirmed, the partnership is not electing out of the centralized audit regime, and the draft is a paper return to Ogden unless the firm e-files.

The tax treatment of the warranty and cost-to-complete reserves is a judgment for a person. The draft adds back $8,600.00 of new provisions and deducts the $4,900.00 paid against the opening reserves, which gives cost of goods sold of $2,884,800.00 and ordinary income of $248,200.00. Form 1125-A line 8, page 1 line 2, Schedule M-1 lines 4 and 7, Schedule K line 1 and item L all move if the reviewer decides differently.

Schedule K-1 item K1 is blank on both K-1s and no box 19 code D amount is shown until a person settles the reserves and the agreement. On the draft's own add-back only the trade payable would count: the general partner's recourse share falls from $12,700.00 to $9,400.00, a $3,300.00 deemed distribution (box 19 code D) that would raise Schedule K line 19a to $243,300.00. If the reserves also count there is no code D. Once item K1 is filled, the K-1 liabilities need a reconciliation to Schedule L.

The client says Form 7004 was filed September 9, 2026; no acknowledgment or proof of mailing exists. Until it is found, the September 15, 2026 due date governs, the return is late, and the election-out window and the K-1 furnishing date cannot be treated as extended.
Washington and local rules were not researched. The federal filing address is settled (Ogden); nothing else about the state is.
No signature. The signature block, date and paid preparer block are blank. Morgan Lee, President of HANGS General Partner Inc, would sign once a reviewer has closed or accepted the open items.

Whole dollars or cents has not been chosen; the client expressed no preference. The draft shows cents. Whole dollars would leave the general partner's item L footing $1 short of its rounded ending balance.

The Form 8832 and its acceptance letter, the partners' Forms 1120 showing June 30 years, the FY2025 Form 1065 as filed and the Forms 1099 are described by the client but not supplied. The required tax year, the Schedule M-3 answer, the FY2025 reserve add-back and the e-file count rest on those statements.

All deductible construction cost sits on Form 1125-A line 5 with an itemized statement; lines 2 and 3 are zero because the ledger does not split land, materials and subcontract labor. Whether the $18,500.00 of closing legal services belongs in cost of goods sold or on page 1 line 21 is for the reviewer.

Schedules K-2 and K-3 were not researched. HANGS has no foreign activity or foreign partner, but both partners are C corporations, which the domestic filing exception may not cover; a person decides whether the schedules or the line 16b box apply.
